title: Moesha
description:
S4 E8 — Birth Control
Moesha gets birth control pills when she decides she would like to lose her virginity to Aaron.  However, things get complicated when Dee finds the pills in her purse.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E9 — A Class Act Christmas
Moesha, Hakeem, and the other employees of the Class Act are held hostage by a man dressed as Santa Claus protesting age discrimination.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E13 — Coach
Mark becomes the new head coach of the undefeated basketball team after Coach Corley quits. He starts to think that he doesn't have what it takes to be a winning coach when the team loses their very first game under his coaching.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E14 — One is the Loneliest Number
After Mark and Denise's break-up, Mark discovers that he really does love her and jumps through hoops to get her back. Nicole and Tyler work together selling candy bars in an effort to win the prize for the most sold, a CD player.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E15 — True Lies
In order to be with his girlfriend, Mark lies to Nicole. Mark allows Nicole to punish him after she realizes that he lied. But soon he is tempted to lie to her again.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E16 — The Ringer
As the new coach of Nicole's floundering all-girl baseball team, Mark conspires to dress Tyler up as a girl to help the team. Baseball greats FRANK ROBINSON (himself) and ALBERT BELLE (himself) also came to help.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E17 — Down in the Dumps
Mark and Vanessa think that they won the lottery but can't find their winning ticket.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E18 — Hero
Mark becomes a local hero but an awards ceremony reveals the truth. ELIHU HARRIS, the mayor of Oakland, guest stars as himself in his acting debut. DICK CLARK also appears as himself.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E19 — Here Comes the Groom
Mark's good advice to Earvin about romance somehow causes Earvin to elope with his new girlfriend, and Earvin's mother wants Mark to stop the couple.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E20 — The Matchmaker
Geneva's crazy Aunt Eunetta (also played by SAUNDRA QUARTERMAN) comes to visit and decides that roommates Mark and Vanessa would be the perfect couple. Nicole is upset when Tyler and his friend won't let her play in their boys-only clubhouse.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E21 — Guy's Night Out
Mark tries to help Geneva's boyfriend become a part of his group of male friends with disastrous results. Nicole hides a stray cat in her room, but Vanessa is allergic to cats.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E22 — High Hopes
It looks like Mark, Geneva and Vanessa may all be leaving Oakland forever due to some unexpected surprises--good and bad--in this season finale cliffhanger.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E21 — Best of Friends
Webster isn't speaking to his best friend David, and George hopes if he apologizes to his friend Bill (with whom he also had a disagreement during a board game), that Webster will make up with his friend too.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E4 — Big Problems
Webster's friend Rob is upset because he feels that he is too tall.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E5 — One More Shot
George takes Webster to a New York Knicks game and introduces him to Patrick Ewing.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E6 — The Triangle
Webster takes a picture and shows it to Katherine, who then starts to think that a neighbor is having an affair.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E7 — Parent Trap
As a lesson in teaching Webster responsibility, George and Katherine switch roles to where they are the kids and Webster is the parent.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E10 — The Crush
A friend of Myles who has a crush on Moesha pretends he cannot read so she can tutor him.  However, after an article she writes about the success she has had with the little student is published in the LA Times, Moesha learns a hard lesson.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E11 — Barking Up The Wrong Tree
Hakeem accepts a job as assistant manager of the Class Act claiming there are financial difficulties at home. Moesha, concerned about his college education, confronts his mother who denies his claims.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E12 — Life Imitating Art
Racial tensions mount in Moesha’s high school after a mural depicting Latin American hero Caesar Chavez is purposely defaced.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E13 — OhMiGod, Fanatic
After Moesha and Kim have a huge fight, Moesha is surprised when MTV shows up at her door to film her bringing her best friend Kim to meet her favorite singer.  Leanne Rimes guest stars.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E14 — The Rite Stuff
Moesha wants to boycott her debutante ball when she learns one of the girls is thrown out of the ceremony because she is pregnant.

S2 E20 — Far From The Tree
When Sandra (Jackée) cleans up her act and takes on a whole new identity for her visiting mother, special guest star Della Reese, she must split her personality to make another out-of-town guest, her 'HUNK DU JOUR,' happy as well.

S2 E21 — A Good Citizen
When Sandra (Jackée) alerts the police that she suspects her current love interest Justin (Sam Scarber) has stolen more than her heart, the detectives set up surveillance headquarters in the home of Mary (Marla Gibbs) and Lester (Hal Williams).

S2 E22 — The Audit
Guest stars Red Buttons and Ron Glass appear in this unique 'Special Episode' of '227' which was videotaped only 24 hours prior to airing, enabling the characters to discuss late-breaking news items.

S3 E1 — My Aching Back
Mary and Sandra vie for a chance to deliver a line in a movie being shot at their building.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E6 — The Courtship Of Eddie's Mother
Following her divorce, Eddie's mom arrives for a visit that coincides with one from Malcolm's dad.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E7 — Trading Spaces
Malcolm and Eddie decide to settle an argument by trading jobs for a day.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E8 — Like Water For Chocolate Cookies
Malcolm faces a difficult decision in order to get Simone to keep making her extraordinary cookies.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E9 — Dream Racer
Eddie ignores Nicolette's premonition and agrees to fill in for an injured race car driver.
